description: Adds up the published starting prices for a chosen path of one to three steps (mapping, sprint, fde). Returns the lines, the sum as a lower bound in EUR excl. VAT, what is not included and what is not published. No discounts, no new prices.

lang.description: Language of the answer: en (English, default) or nl (Dutch).

path.description: One to three different steps in the order you would take them: mapping (Information Flow Mapping Session), sprint (FDE Build Sprint), fde (FDE 30-60-90 engagement).

name: estimate_engagement
title: Add up published starting prices
